view: Command Center cover: LEONIDA brand and fan-made disclaimer, platinum progress ring, trophy checklist with search and grade/state filters, the expanded Shootist guide with its Exophase + PSNProfiles citation visible, smart-planner next recommendation, risk summary, export/import/share controls — all on the same fixed demo progress (16 of 55 earned)

Player Toolkit: validated JSON export/import with backup status and shareable summary, grade and category statistics, the trophy audit summary (guides passing, evidence honestly labelled), and the personal trophy journal whose notes travel inside the export
